title: DEV infrastructure
description: Shared DEV Stack, workers, hosts and dependencies over a run's time range (DEV-only; provisioned on the load VM).

list.name: stack
list.label: Stack host
list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket: v.defaultBucket, tag: "host", predicate: (r) => r.env == "dev" and r._measurement == "http_all_total_duration", start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)

list.name: worker_type
list.label: Worker type
list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket: v.defaultBucket, tag: "worker_type", predicate: (r) => r.env == "dev" and r._measurement == "workers_queues_len", start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)

list.name: node
list.label: Host
list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket: v.defaultBucket, tag: "host", predicate: (r) => r.env == "dev" and r._measurement == "cpu", start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)

panels.title: Requests/s by host
panels.description: Shared DEV activity, collected once a minute: background conditions for a run, not test-organization usage.

targets.query:
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.env == "dev" and r._measurement == "http_all_total_duration" and r._field == "count" and r.host =~ /^${stack:regex}$/)
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> group(columns: ["host", "_time"])
  |> sum()
  |> group(columns: ["host"])

panels.title: Mean job duration by worker type
panels.description: Interval duration over interval job count, per window. Shared DEV activity, collected once a minute: background conditions for a run, not test-organization usage.

targets.query:
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.env == "dev" and r._measurement == "workers_exec_durations" and (r._field == "sum" or r._field == "count") and r.worker_type =~ /^${worker_type:regex}$/)
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> group(columns: ["worker_type", "_field", "_time"])
  |> sum()
  |> group(columns: ["worker_type", "_time"])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.count and exists r.sum and r.count > 0.0)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, worker_type: r.worker_type, _value: r.sum / r.count}))
  |> group(columns: ["worker_type"])
